meta.name: flowchart
meta.description: 生成教育/科普类流程图、概念图、原理演示的动画 HTML 页面。用 CSS/SVG 绘制节点和连线，支持流动箭头、逐步出现、hover 高亮等动画效果。适合技术讲解、视频科普、PPT 配图场景。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将流程图制作成带动画的演示页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把抽象概念变成直观的动画演示
copy.tagline_en: Create animated flowcharts and concept maps for education
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn abstract concepts into clear animated visuals.

howto.what: 根据你描述的概念、流程或模型,生成一个可单独打开的动画 HTML 页面,用节点和连线画出流程图或概念图。内容会依次出现、连线流动,悬停可高亮看说明;若不明确会先问演示内容、深度和风格,完成后告知保存路径并询问是否调整。
howto.when: 当你提到“流程图”“概念图”“原理演示”等触发词,或描述“步骤流程”“对比”“原理机制”等内容时触发;典型用于技术讲解、视频科普、PPT 配图。

say.text: 帮我画一个 API 调用链的流程图
say.note: 会生成节点依次出现、连线流动的 HTML 动画。

say.text: 对比一下 RNN 和 LSTM 的区别
say.note: 生成并排对比图,悬停可看说明。

say.text: 展示 GPU 并行架构的工作原理
say.note: 生成系统概览风格的可视化页面。

howto.what_en: Creates a standalone animated HTML page drawing a flow, model, or idea as a flowchart/concept map. Nodes appear one by one, connections animate, hover shows explanations. If unclear it asks first, then reports the save path.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "flowchart", "concept map", "principle demo", or similar terms, or asks about steps, comparisons, or how something works — useful for teaching, videos, or slides.

say_en.text: Make a flowchart of an API call chain
say_en.note: Animated HTML page; nodes appear in order, arrows flow.

say_en.text: Compare RNN and LSTM side by side
say_en.note: Generates a comparison chart with hover explanations.

say_en.text: Show how a GPU's parallel architecture works
say_en.note: Creates a system-overview style visualization page.
